title: A13 candidate settled visual follow-up
scope: One read-only local page load of the existing after build. No source edits, wallet actions or performance acceptance.

screenshot.method: CDP Page.captureScreenshot fromSurface:true after normal finite animation completion and two requestAnimationFrame callbacks

postCaptureFileChecks.interpretation: The original and settled PNGs contain the same header, language picker and hero pixels. The settled PNG is byte-for-byte identical to the public baseline. No source/artifact omission was reproduced; this does not diagnose a differing inline preview.

limitations: This single follow-up verifies settled pixels and browser rendering state, not a new performance comparison.
The earlier >=95% predicate was a CSS opacity milestone. It was not proof of compositor completion at that instant. It remains a diagnostic sample.
No animations were forced, disabled or shortened. Existing finite entrance animations finished normally before two RAF callbacks and a fromSurface compositor screenshot.
No source, assets, SDK, dependencies, session logic or deployment changed. No wallet interaction was performed.
